stories.title: Il petrolio prosegue discesa, il Brent sotto i 100 dollari

en.title: Oil continues decline, Brent falls below 100 dollars
en.summary: Brent crude has fallen below 100 dollars per barrel while WTI also continues its downward trend, reaching 89 dollars.

stories.title: La fuga dei medici dagli ospedali, sono più le dimissioni dei pensionamenti: “Turni massacranti”

en.title: Doctors fleeing hospitals, resignations exceed retirements: "Grueling shifts"
en.summary: Union data shows 3,700 physicians voluntarily left hospitals and 2,800 retired in 2025, with doctors citing exhausting work conditions and wages below European standards.

stories.title: Chiesto l'arresto per corruzione dell'ex vicepresidente Regione Sicilia Armao

en.title: Arrest sought for corruption of former Sicily Region vice president Armao
en.summary: An arrest warrant has been requested for Armao, a lawyer and husband of a former Justice Ministry chief of staff, following searches at his home and offices.

stories.title: ++ Sindacato medici, nel 2025 + 150% dimissioni, superati i pensionamenti ++

en.title: Medical union reports 150% increase in resignations in 2025, exceeding retirements
en.summary: A union study shows a surge in voluntary departures from hospitals, with 43 resignations for every 100 new hires.

stories.title: Corruzione, la procura di Palermo chiede l’arresto dell’ex vice presidente della Regione Armao

en.title: Corruption, Palermo prosecutor seeks arrest of former regional vice president Armao
en.summary: Prosecutors are seeking the arrest of Armao, husband of a former chief of staff to Justice Minister Nordio, in connection with a corruption investigation involving bribes related to an environmental authorization commission that Armao previously chaired. Regional deputy Giuseppe Lombardo and other professionals are also implicated.

stories.title: Corruzione a Palermo, domiciliari per Armao, ex vice presidente della Regione

en.title: Corruption in Palermo, house arrest for Armao, former regional vice president
en.summary: Prosecutors have requested house arrest for Armao, former president of the environmental authorization commission, and other suspects in a corruption investigation until August.

stories.title: Le Borse di oggi, 2 ottobre. Spread ancora in rialzo. Il Brent scende sotto i 100 dollari

en.title: Stock markets today, October 2. Spread rising further. Brent falls below 100 dollars
en.summary: Government bond yields continued to face upward pressure while Asian markets closed sharply lower and European markets opened slightly higher. Brent crude fell below 100 dollars per barrel.

stories.title: Francia, la rivolta degli studenti: 1900 fermi, il 90% sono minorenni

en.title: France, student uprising: 1900 arrests, 90% are minors
en.summary: French authorities arrested 1900 people during student protests, with 90 percent being minors. Education Minister Geffray reported that 65 school employees, including 40 principals, were injured.

stories.title: Danni cerebrali dopo le corse: chiude una delle montagne russe più famose della California

en.title: Brain damage after rides: one of California's most famous roller coasters closes
en.summary: X2, a major attraction at Six Flags Magic Mountain near Los Angeles, has closed following reports of brain injuries connected to rides on the coaster.

stories.title: L'agonia di Christa Pike, cronaca di una esecuzione fallita

en.title: The agony of Christa Pike, chronicle of a failed execution
en.summary: A death row inmate's execution in the United States involved two injections that failed to cause death, with witnesses describing disturbing scenes. The incident raises questions about whether the execution method constitutes torture under law.

stories.title: Sopravvive a due dosi di iniezione letale: il Tennessee sospende l’esecuzione di Christa Pike

en.title: Survives two lethal injections: Tennessee suspends execution of Christa Pike
en.summary: Convicted of murder in 1996, Christa Pike's execution was halted after two pentobarbital doses failed. Governor Bill Lee suspended proceedings and ordered an independent investigation.

stories.title: Usa, la Corte Suprema dà il via libera all’esecuzione di Christa Pike, ma lei sopravvive a due iniezioni. È in condizioni critiche

en.title: USA, Supreme Court approves execution of Christa Pike, but she survives two injections. She is in critical condition
en.summary: A 50-year-old woman condemned to death for a crime committed as a young adult survived two execution injections and remains in critical condition. The governor has suspended all capital executions for the year.

stories.title: Fondi europei 28-34: le regioni più ricche sfidano l’indecisione del governo e vanno in “autogestione”

en.title: European funds 2028-34: wealthier regions challenge government indecision and move to 'self-management'
en.summary: A group of northern Italian regions are developing an independent plan for European funding allocation while awaiting government clarity on their role in the next funding period, attempting to overcome ministry delays.

stories.title: Franchising, in aumento chi investe all’estero

en.title: Franchising, growth in those investing abroad
en.summary: At least 20 percent of Italian franchising brands plan to expand internationally over the next three years, joining the 41 percent of Italian chains already operating outside the country.

stories.title: Eni, via allo sconto del 20% per mondo agricolo e della pesca su gasolio e benzina

en.title: Eni launches 20% discount for agriculture and fishing sector on diesel and petrol
en.summary: Eni is extending a fuel price reduction to agricultural and fishing businesses through its Enilive brand, effective from October 2, allowing discounted purchases of diesel and petrol.

stories.title: Maire apripista nella formazione di specialisti sulla transizione energetica

en.title: Maire leads the way in training specialists on energy transition
en.summary: Maire is launching Italy's first specialized higher education program on energy transition in Rome in November, addressing skills gaps and supporting employment for disadvantaged youth.

stories.title: Ericsson e Zte, a rischio 212 lavoratori diretti e scatta l’allarme nelle Tlc

en.title: Ericsson and Zte, 212 direct workers at risk and alarm raised in telecom sector
en.summary: Two major global telecommunications infrastructure companies face workforce reductions in Italy, raising concerns within the telecom industry.
